title: Net mangrove area lost by region, 1980-2005

source.name: The World's Mangroves 1980-2005
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

notes: Asia had the largest net mangrove loss of any region (over 1.9 million hectares), versus about 0.69 million in North & Central America and about 0.51 million in Africa.
